blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning models allocate extra computation at inference time and present their answers as the product of deliberate thought. If this deliberation works the way dual-process accounts of human cognition suggest, longer thinking should weaken the classic decision biases that fast, intuitive judgment produces. We test that prediction. Using 30 vignettes covering six biases (anchoring, framing, loss aversion, escalation of commitment, availability, confirmation) drawn from an established benchmark, we run a dose-response study across four model families, pairing each reasoning model with a matched non-reasoning sibling and requesting thinking ceilings of 0, 1,024, 4,096, and 8,192 tokens, for 12,350 API calls. Because a requested ceiling is not the same as realized deliberation, we log the reasoning tokens each call consumed and use realized consumption as the dose. Three results follow. First, reasoning models are not less biased than their siblings; the point estimate leans the other way in every family, but the item-level pooled contrast is not reliable (Delta = +0.031, t(29) = 1.45, p = .157). Second, bias magnitude does not reliably fall as realized deliberation grows: across the ranges these models actually produced, no slope is significantly negative, and where anything moves it is the signed score drifting further from the human direction. Third, anchoring is the only bias in the human direction (d = 1.89). Four of the other five lean the opposite way in all seven models; at the item level, with five items per bias, that reversal is reliable for framing and directional for escalation of commitment, confirmation, and loss aversion, while availability is absent. A one-line instruction to restate the anchor before answering lowered anchoring on all five anchoring items, which no amount of additional thinking did, although with five items the effect does not reach significance (p = .057). The results argue against treating test-time reasoning as a rationality guarantee and for auditing deployed models bias by bias.
blocks.zh: 理性模型在推论时间分配额外计算,并将答案作为深思熟虑的产物. 如果这种考虑能按照人类认知的双重过程的叙述方式发挥作用,那么较长的思考应该削弱快速、直观的判断所产生的经典决定偏差。 我们测试这个预测。 利用30个Vignette从既定基准中抽取的6个偏差(选择、设定、损失厌恶、承诺的升级、可用性、确认),我们对4个模范家庭进行了剂量反应研究,将每个推理模型与对应的非理性兄弟配对,并请求设定0、1,024、4,096和8,192个符号,用于12,350个API电话。 由于要求的上限与实际考虑不同,我们记录了每次调用的理由符号,并将实际消费作为剂量。 后有三果. 首先,推理模型的偏颇性不亚于兄弟姐妹;分数估计在每一个家族中反向倾斜,但项目级集合对比不可靠(Delta = + 0.031,t(29) = 1.45,p = 157). 第二,倾斜度不会随着实际考虑的增加而可靠地下降:在这些模型实际产生的范围内,没有斜率明显为负值,在任何移动的地方,都是签字得分从人类方向进一步漂移. 第三,锚定是人类方向的唯一偏差(d=1.89)。 其他五种模式中,有四种是相反的;在项目一级,每取偏差有五种,这种倒置对于确定和引导承诺、确认和避免损失的升级是可靠的,而不存在。 一项一行指示,在回答所有五个锚地的下锚问题之前,要重用锚地,但没有任何额外思考,尽管有五个锚地,效果并不重要(p=.057)。 结果反对将试验时间推理视为合理性的保证,反对对带有偏见的模型加以审计。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Reasoning models such as OpenAI’s o-series, DeepSeek-R1, and the thinking variants of Claude and Qwen spend a controllable budget of tokens on an internal deliberation phase before committing to an answer [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . The appeal is intuitive: a system that thinks longer should decide better, and test-time compute has in fact improved performance on mathematics, coding, and other verifiable tasks [ 4 , 5 ] . These models are now placed in decision support, where the questions are not math problems but judgment calls: estimates, trade-offs, and choices between framed options. Whether extra thinking helps there is a different question, and it is the one this paper asks.
blocks.zh: OpenAI的O-series, DeepSeek-R1等理性模型,以及克洛德和Quen的思维变体,在承诺回答[1,2,3]之前,在内部审议阶段花费了可控制的代币预算. 上诉是直观的:一种认为更长时间应该更好的决定的系统,而测试时间计算事实上改善了数学,编码,以及其他可核查的任务[4,5]的性能. 这些模型现在放在决策支持中,其中的问题不是数学问题,而是判断需要:估计、权衡和框架选项的选择。 额外的思考是否有助于有一个不同的问题,而这正是本文提出的问题。

blocks.en: The question has a natural home in dual-process theory. In the human literature, biases such as anchoring and framing are attributed to fast, associative processing, and deliberate reasoning is the mechanism that can override them [ 6 , 7 ] . The analogy between a reasoning trace and this deliberative mode is common in discussions of test-time compute, and it makes a concrete, falsifiable prediction: if the analogy holds, bias should shrink as deliberation grows. To our reading, this dose-response prediction has not been tested under controlled conditions, although its ingredients exist. Benchmarks now document a wide range of cognitive biases in language models [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , and separate work studies how reasoning traces relate to model behavior [ 12 , 13 ] . What is missing is a design that holds the stimuli fixed, pairs reasoning models with matched non-reasoning siblings, and varies deliberation as an experimental factor while checking how much deliberation actually occurred.
blocks.zh: 这个问题在双过程理论中有一个自然的家. 在人类文献中,锚定和架设等偏差归因于快速的,关联的处理,而故意的推理是能够凌驾于它们的[6,7]的机制. 推理跟踪与这种审议模式的类比在关于测试时间计算的讨论中很常见,它提出了具体而可伪造的预测:如果类比维持,随着审议的增长,偏差应该会缩小. 在我们看来,这种剂量反应预测没有在可控条件下进行测试,尽管其成分存在. 基准现在记录了语言模型中的各种认知偏差[8,9,10,11],以及推理痕迹与模型行为的关系的单独工作研究[12,13]. 所缺少的是一种设计,它把刺激固定下来,配对推理模型和匹配的非理性兄弟姐妹,并作为一种实验因素进行不同的审议,同时检查实际审议次数。

blocks.en: The answer matters for practice. If deliberation reduces bias, allocating compute becomes a documented mitigation with a measurable cost-benefit curve. If it does not, then the trust that a longer visible deliberation invites is not backed by better judgment, and bias mitigation has to come from somewhere else. Either outcome changes how a deployed system should be configured; neither can be assumed from capability benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 答案对实践很重要。 如果考虑会减少偏差,分配计算就会成为具有可计量成本效益曲线的有记录的缓解措施。 如果不这样做,那么,人们相信一个更能见度较长的审议邀请不会得到更好的判断,而减少偏见必须来自其他地方。 这两种结果都改变了部署的系统应如何配置;也不能从能力基准中假定。

blocks.en: We therefore run a dose-response study. From the 30,000-test benchmark of Malberg et al. [ 8 ] we freeze a battery of 30 decision vignettes covering six biases with distinct theoretical roots: anchoring [ 6 ] , the framing effect [ 14 ] , loss aversion [ 15 ] , escalation of commitment [ 16 ] , the availability heuristic [ 17 ] , and confirmation bias [ 18 ] . Each vignette exists in a control and a bias-manipulated version, and every response is a choice on a fixed ordinal scale, which yields a bounded, direction-aware bias score. We administer the battery to seven models from four families (Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen), crossing each reasoning model with requested thinking ceilings of 0, 1,024, 4,096, and 8,192 tokens and sampling each cell ten times, for 12,350 calls. A third condition on the anchoring items forces the model to restate the anchor before answering. For every call we log the reasoning tokens actually consumed, which turns out to matter: the requested ceiling and the realized deliberation diverge in ways that differ by provider.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们进行剂量反应研究。 从马尔贝格等的30,000个测试基准. [8] 我们冻结了30个裁决组,其中包含6个具有不同理论根源的偏差:锚定[6]、框架效应[14]、损失厌恶[15]、承诺的升级[16]、可用热度[17]和确认偏差[18]。 每个vignette都存在于一个控制和偏差操纵的版本中,每个响应都是在固定的正弦尺度上的选择,它产生一个有界限,有方向意识的偏差分数. 我们管理电池给来自四个家庭(Anthropic、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Quen)的7个型号,跨越每个推理型号,要求的思维上限为:0、1,024、4,096和8,192个信使,每个细胞10次取样,接听12,350个电话。 锚地物品的第三个条件迫使模型在回答之前重述锚地. 每一次通话,我们都会记录实际消耗的推理符号, 结果是重要的: 要求的上限和已经实现的考虑 不同的方式, 不同的提供者。

blocks.en: The paper makes four contributions: • a dose-response design for bias in reasoning models, with matched reasoning/non-reasoning pairs in four model families, a requested thinking ceiling as the manipulated factor, and realized reasoning tokens as the measured dose; • evidence that reasoning does not confer resistance: no family shows a reasoning model with lower bias magnitude than its comparator, and no model’s bias magnitude reliably declines as realized deliberation grows; • a presence-versus-reversal taxonomy in which anchoring alone appears in the human direction while four of the other five biases lean the opposite way in every model tested, with the item-level reliability of each reversal stated; • a practical observation: forcing the model to verbalize the anchor lowered anchoring on every anchoring item, which no increase in deliberation did, at the cost of one prompt line. We release the frozen battery, collection harness, scored dataset, per-call token usage, and analysis code. 1 1 1 https://github.com/obadaKraishan/anchored-minds

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: This section situates the study in three lines of work: measurements of cognitive bias in language models, the test-time reasoning paradigm, and analyses of what reasoning traces actually do.
blocks.zh: 本节将研究定位为三行工作:测量语言模型中的认知偏差,测试时间推理范式,分析推理痕迹的实际作用.

blocks.en: II-A Cognitive biases in language models
blocks.zh: II-A 语文模式的认知偏差

blocks.en: Behavioral experiments borrowed from psychology have become a standard instrument for studying language models. Binz and Schulz probed GPT-3 with classic vignettes and found several human-like errors [ 10 ] . Hagendorff et al. reported that intuitive biases present in earlier GPT models weakened or vanished in ChatGPT, an early sign that alignment training reshapes bias profiles [ 19 ] . Itzhak et al. showed the complementary effect: instruction tuning can also introduce biases that the base model lacked [ 20 ] . Larger inventories followed. Echterhoff et al. measured biases in managerial decision scenarios [ 9 ] , and Malberg et al. built the benchmark used here, 30 biases instantiated in 200 scenarios and validated across 20 models [ 8 ] . Knipper et al. assessed eight biases across a broad model panel and reported bias-consistent behavior in 18 to 57 percent of instances; among their findings, the reasoning-oriented QwQ-32B and DeepSeek-R1 showed more resistance to framing specifically, with no comparable gain on other biases [ 11 ] . Related strands document social forms of bias pressure, including sycophancy [ 21 , 22 ] and biases that emerge at the population level when model agents interact [ 23 ] . This literature establishes that biases can be measured, but it treats each model as a fixed object; the amount of inference-time deliberation is not manipulated, and whether a model’s response moves against the human direction, rather than merely failing to move with it, is not always distinguished.
blocks.zh: 从心理学中借入的行为实验已成为研究语言模型的标准工具. Binz和Schulz用经典花纹来探测出GPT-3,并发现了数个类似人类的错误[10]. Hagendorff等人报告说,早先的GPT模型中存在的直觉偏差在ChatGPT中被削弱或消失,这是调整训练重塑偏差特征的早期迹象 [19]. 伊扎克等编. 显示互补效应:指令调谐也可以带来基础模型所缺乏的偏差[20]. 随后是更多的库存。 Echterhoff等人测量了管理决策情景中的偏差[9],以及Malberg等人。 建立了此处使用的基准,在200种情景中进行了30种偏见的即时分析,并在20种模式中进行了验证[8]。 Knipper 等 (英语). 评估了8个广泛的模型面板的偏差,并报告了18%至57%的案例中与偏差一致的行为;在调查结果中,以推理为导向的QwQ-32B和DeepSeek-R1显示出了更强烈的抵制具体设定,对其他偏差没有类似的收益[11]. 相关方面记录了社会形式的偏见压力,包括模式代理人相互作用时在人口一级出现的[21、22]和偏见[23]。 这一文献确定,偏见是可以衡量的,但它将每个模型视为固定对象;推论时间审议的数量没有被操纵,一个模型的反应是否违背人的方向,而不是仅仅不随它而去,并不总是被区分.

blocks.en: II-B Test-time reasoning
blocks.zh: II-B 试验时间推理

blocks.en: Chain-of-thought prompting first showed that eliciting intermediate steps improves accuracy [ 24 ] . Current reasoning models internalize the idea: they are trained to produce an extended thinking phase whose length can be capped by the caller [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , and allocating more of this test-time compute can beat scaling parameters on verifiable tasks [ 4 , 5 ] . The controllable budget is what makes the present study possible: it turns deliberation into an independent variable rather than a model property. As Section III-E shows, the control is less direct than the API surface suggests, which is why we measure consumption rather than trusting the request.
blocks.zh: 启发思维链首先表明,引出中间步骤可提高准确性[24]。 目前的推理模型将这个想法内部化:他们经过训练,可以产生一个可被呼叫者封顶的延长思维阶段[1,2,3],并且分配更多的这种测试时间计算可以击败可核查任务的缩放参数[4,5]. 可控制预算是使本研究成为可能的原因:它把审议变成一个独立的可变因素,而不是一个示范财产. 如第三节-E所显示,控制比API表面所显示的更不直接,这就是为什么我们衡量消费而不是信任请求的原因.

blocks.en: II-C What reasoning traces do
blocks.zh: 二级C级 推理的痕迹是什么

blocks.en: A separate line of work cautions against reading the trace as the computation. Turpin et al. showed that chain-of-thought explanations can rationalize answers driven by cues the text never mentions [ 12 ] , and Chen et al. found the same pattern inside reasoning models, which verbalize the hints that moved them only a minority of the time [ 13 ] . Shojaee et al. documented reasoning effort that collapses precisely where problems get hard [ 25 ] . These results question the deliberation analogy from the inside, by inspecting traces. We question it from the outside, by testing its behavioral prediction: whatever the trace contains, more of it should produce less bias if it functions as System-2 deliberation. The two approaches are complementary, and our results agree with theirs.
blocks.zh: 单独的一行工作提醒人们不要将痕量读作计算. 图尔平等. 以及Chen et al. 在推理模型内部发现了同样的模式,这些模式将感动它们的提示口头化,只是当时[13]的少数. Shojaee等编. 恰好在问题变得棘手的地方崩溃。 这些结果通过检查痕迹,从内部对审议类比提出质疑。 我们通过测试它的行为预测 来从外部质疑它:不管它的痕迹包含什么, 如果它作为System-2审议程序发挥作用,它中更多的应该产生更少的偏差。 这两种做法是相辅相成的,我们的成果与它们一致。

blocks.en: III Study Design
blocks.zh: 三. 研究设计

blocks.en: This section describes the research questions, the stimulus battery, the model panel, the experimental conditions and what the gateway did with them, the bias metric and its interpretation, and the collection procedure with its data-quality checks.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍研究问题、刺激电池、模型面板、实验条件和网关对它们做了什么、偏差度量及其解释,以及收集程序及其数据质量检查。

blocks.en: III-A Research questions
blocks.zh: 三.A 研究问题

blocks.en: The study is organized around four questions, fixed before data collection. • RQ1. Do reasoning models show smaller bias magnitudes than matched non-reasoning models of the same family? • RQ2. Does bias decrease as deliberation grows? • RQ3. Which of the six biases are present in the human direction, absent, or reversed, and which respond to deliberation? • RQ4. Does forcing the model to verbalize the anchor change anchoring susceptibility?
blocks.zh: 这项研究围绕四个问题进行,在数据收集之前固定下来。 • RQ1。 推理模型显示的偏差大小是否小于同一家族的相匹配的非理性模型? • RQ2。 偏见是否随着审议的增长而减少? • RQ3。 这六种偏见中,有哪一种在人的方向上存在、不存在或扭转,哪些是对审议的回应? • RQ4。 是否迫使模型将主播语言化 改变主播的易感性?

blocks.en: III-B Benchmark and battery
blocks.zh: 三-B 基准和电池

blocks.en: Stimuli come from the cognitive-bias benchmark of Malberg et al. [ 8 ] , which instantiates each bias as paired prompts: a control version of a managerial decision scenario and a treatment version containing the bias manipulation, both answered on a fixed ordinal scale presented as numbered options. We selected six biases on theoretical grounds, covering numeric estimation (anchoring), choice architecture (framing, loss aversion, escalation of commitment), and belief-driven judgment (availability, confirmation). For each bias we sampled five items from distinct scenarios with a fixed seed (42) and froze the resulting 30-item battery before any experimental call was made; the battery did not change afterwards. Ten items use a 7-point scale and twenty use an 11-point scale. Each benchmark item carries a direction parameter k ∈ { − 1 , + 1 } k\in\{-1,+1\} and, where applicable, a scale-reversal flag for the treatment prompt, which we apply as specified so that positive scores always mean movement in the direction the bias predicts for humans.

[8],它将每个偏差作为配对的提示即时解答:管理决策情景的控制版本和包含偏差操纵的处理版本,两者都以固定的正则比例给出了编号选项. 我们选择了6个基于理论的偏差,包括数字估计(安打),选择结构(香气,失恋,承诺的升级)和信仰驱动的判断(可用性,确认)。 对于每一种偏差,我们从不同的假想中抽取了5个有固定种子的电池(42个),并在进行实验前冻结了所产生的30个电池;此后电池没有改变。 十件物品采用七分制,二十件采用十一分制. 每个基准项都带有一个方向参数k {{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{}克\in{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{}{{{{{{{{{{}{{{{{{{{}{{{{}{{{{{{}{{{{{}{{{{{{}{{{}{{}}},以及适用情况下,治疗快件的正反向旗帜;我们按规定适用该标记,以便正分数总是指对人类的偏见预测方向的运动。

blocks.en: III-C Model panel
blocks.zh: 三-C型号面板

blocks.en: Table I lists the panel: seven models from four families, chosen to span capability tiers and open versus closed weights while keeping a matched reasoning/non-reasoning pair inside each family. All calls were routed through a single API gateway (OpenRouter) so that the reasoning budget could be requested with one uniform parameter. Two properties of the panel required design decisions. For the OpenAI family no separate non-reasoning sibling of GPT-5.1 was available, so the comparator is the same model at budget 0 with thinking disabled, which holds the weights constant and toggles only deliberation. DeepSeek-R1 and the Qwen3 thinking variant cannot disable thinking at all: requests to turn it off were rejected or ignored, and at a zero budget the models thought anyway. We therefore treat budget 0 as undefined for these two models and use their instruct siblings (DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3-Instruct) as the family zero points, which is what the paired design was built for. This means the reasoning contrast is held at constant weights for the Claude and OpenAI families and crosses a sibling boundary for DeepSeek and Qwen; we return to this in the limitations.

blocks.en: III-D Conditions and budget manipulation
blocks.zh: 三-D 条件和预算操纵

blocks.en: Every battery item was administered in a control and a treatment condition. Anchoring items received a third condition for RQ4: the treatment prompt plus one instruction to restate every number mentioned in the prompt before answering. All prompts ended with a fixed answer-format instruction (“Answer: Option ⟨ \langle number ⟩ \rangle ”). Reasoning models ran at requested ceilings of 0, 1,024, 4,096, and 8,192 thinking tokens (the two no-disable models at the three positive ceilings); instruct models ran at budget 0 only. Each model × \times budget × \times item × \times condition cell was sampled ten times at temperature 1.0, giving 12,350 calls in total. Requests used asynchronous collection with retry and checkpointing; the token ceiling for thinking calls reserved a fixed answer allowance on top of the budget, which a pilot showed was necessary to keep long deliberations from truncating the visible answer.
blocks.zh: 每一个电池都处于控制和治疗状态。 悬索物品获得了RQ4的第三个条件:治疗提示外加一个指示,在回答前重述提示中提到的每个号码. 所有提示都以固定的答题格式指导结尾(“答题:选项\\\\ langle number \\\rangle ”). 说明理由的模型按要求的上限运行,上限为:0、1 024、4 096和8 192个思维符(三个正上限的两个无残疾模型);指示模型仅以预算0运行。 每一个型号 \times 预算\\times 项目\times \times 条件细胞在1.0温度下被抽取了十次,总共给出了12,350通电话. 请求使用重试和检查的同步收集;思维呼叫的象征性上限在预算之外保留了固定的答题津贴,一个试点显示,为了避免长时间的审议中断可见的答案,有必要这样做。

blocks.en: III-E Requested ceiling versus realized deliberation
blocks.zh: 三-E 要求的最高限额与已实现的审议

blocks.en: A requested ceiling is an instruction to the provider, not a measurement of what the model did. The gateway’s documentation states that Anthropic models honour the ceiling directly, that OpenAI reasoning models accept only an effort level and have the ceiling converted to one, and says nothing about how open-weight providers treat it. We therefore logged the reasoning tokens reported in the usage field of every response and treat that count, rather than the request, as the dose. Table II summarises the result, and it differs by provider in three ways.
blocks.zh: 要求的上限是对供应商的指示,而不是对模型所作所为的衡量。 网关的文献指出,Anthropic模型直接遵守了天花板,OpenAI推理模型只接受一个努力水平,并将天花板转换成一个天花板,对开放重量提供者如何对待天花板却一言不发。 因此,我们记录了在每个反应的使用领域所报告的推理标志,并将这一数量而不是请求视为剂量。 表二总结了结果,并按提供者有三种不同。

blocks.en: For Claude, the ceiling was honoured and consumption rose with it, from zero at budget 0 to a mean of 437, 575, and 620 tokens at the three positive ceilings; no call exceeded its ceiling, and the model never came close to the larger ones. For GPT-5.1, thinking was off at budget 0 and nearly constant above it, at 116 to 118 tokens regardless of the requested ceiling, which is the effort-tier conversion at work: the three requested levels produced one realized level. For DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3, the ceiling was not enforced. Both models consumed between 1,074 and 1,617 tokens on average at every setting including budget 0, and at the 1,024 ceiling 79% of R1 calls and 52% of Qwen3 calls exceeded it. Consumption rose slightly between the 1,024 and 4,096 settings and was flat beyond.
blocks.zh: 对克洛德来说,上限得到了尊重,消费随之而上升,从预算0的零增长到平均437 575,3个正上限的620个令牌;没有呼叫超过其上限,模型从未接近较大的. 就GPT-5.1而言,在预算0和预算上几乎保持不变,无论要求的上限是多少,都是116至118个符号,这就是工作中的努力级转换:要求的三个级别产生了一个实现的水平。 对于DeepSeek-R1和Qun3,上限没有执行. 两种型号平均消耗在1,074至1,617个令牌之间,包括预算0,在1,024的上限内,79%的R1电话和52%的Qune3电话都超过了这一标准。 消费在1,024至4,096个环境之间略有增加,超出这些环境的幅度是平平的。

blocks.en: Two consequences follow for the analysis. The budget-0 contrast for Claude and GPT-5.1 is a true zero-deliberation comparison at constant weights. And the dose-response question (RQ2) is answered on realized tokens: per model, we regress bias on log 2 ⁡ ( realized tokens + 1 ) \log_{2}(\text{realized tokens}+1) within the range that model actually produced, rather than on the requested label.

blocks.en: What the score measures deserves one paragraph. The control and treatment versions of an item carry the same decision-relevant information; by construction they differ only in the manipulation (a numeric anchor, a gain or loss frame, a prior commitment, and so on) that the bias literature identifies as normatively irrelevant to the choice. Any systematic shift between the two therefore indexes sensitivity to an irrelevant feature of the prompt. That is the sense in which we use “bias”: susceptibility to the manipulation, not a judgment about the quality of either answer in isolation. Magnitude | s | |s| is the size of that susceptibility, and the sign says whether the shift runs with or against the human pattern. A model with | s | = 0 |s|=0 is one whose answer does not depend on the irrelevant feature; a model with large | s | |s| in either direction is one whose answer does.
blocks.zh: 计分措施应该有一个段落。 某一项的控制和处理版本载有与决策相关的相同信息;通过构建,它们仅在操纵(一个数字锚地,一个损益框架,一个先前的承诺等)方面有所不同,而偏差文献认为这些操纵在规范上与选择无关. 因此,两者之间的任何系统转变都表明敏感度与迅速性无关。 这就是我们使用“偏见”的含义:容易被操纵,而不是孤立地判断两个答案的质量。 Magnitude | s| s| s| s| s| s|是这种易感的大小,而标志上写着这种转变是随人模式而行还是与人模式相悖. 一个具有QQ s = 0 s = 0 s = 0的模型,其答案不依赖于不相干的特点;一个具有大QQ s = QQ s 的模型,其答案在任一方向都是如此.

blocks.en: III-G Procedure and data quality
blocks.zh: 三-G 程序和数据质量

blocks.en: All 12,350 calls completed without API failures. Answers were extracted with a tiered, range-aware parser (strict format first, then boxed and free-text patterns, all restricted to the item’s option range so that echoed stimulus numbers cannot be mistaken for answers). On analyzable data the parse rate was 99.4%, at or near 100% for five of the seven models. Two exclusions are documented rather than repaired. First, the budget-0 responses of the two no-disable models are excluded by design as described above. Second, Qwen3-Instruct provided a raw quantity (for example, a percentage) instead of an option index in 7.2% of its responses, mostly on anchoring estimation items; these responses were excluded, leaving seven of its 65 condition cells below eight samples but every cell with at least two; five scored cells are affected, 1.0% of the 510-cell grid. The scored dataset contains one row per model × \times budget × \times item cell (510 rows).
blocks.zh: 所有12,350个电话都没有API故障就完成了. 答案是用分级的、有范围意识的解析器提取的(先是限制格式,然后是框式和自由文字模式,所有答案都局限于项目的选项范围,以便反射的刺激数字不能被误认为答案)。 根据可分析的数据,7个模型中的5个模型的剖析率为99.4%,或接近100%。 有两个排除情形是记录在案的,而不是修复的。 首先,如上所述,两种无残疾模式的预算-0反应被设计排除在外。 第二,Quen3-Instruct提供了原始数量(例如,一个百分比),而不是其7.2%的答复中的选项指数,大多是锁定估计项目;这些答复被排除在外,其65个条件细胞中有7个低于8个样本,但每个细胞至少有2个;5个得分细胞受到影响,占510个细胞网格的1.0%。 得分数据集包含每个型号一行××时预算××时项目单元格(510行).

blocks.en: The unit of independent observation is the item. Where a comparison pools across models or budgets, the same 30 items recur, so we aggregate to the item level before testing and report item-clustered bootstrap intervals. Where a test is confined to one bias, only its five items are independent, so per-bias tests use the t t distribution with four degrees of freedom on the five item means; Wald tests from mixed models assume many clusters and overstate significance at this size. Mixed models with a random item intercept are used where all 30 items enter. Within-family contrasts use paired t t -tests and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests over the 30 items with Cohen’s d z d_{z} ; dose-response uses per-item ordinary-least-squares slopes on log 2 ⁡ ( realized tokens + 1 ) \log_{2}(\text{realized tokens}+1) together with mixed models; Holm correction is applied within each family of tests.

Loss aversion shows the largest mean reversal in the battery ( M = − 0.586 M=-0.586 , reaching − 0.87 -0.87 for Qwen3-Instruct) but also the widest item-clustered interval ( [ − 0.914 , + 0.031 ] [-0.914,+0.031] , p Holm = .256 p_{\text{Holm}}=.256 ): the five loss-aversion items disagree about how far the models lean, even though all seven models lean the same way. Availability is small, not reliable at the item level ( M = − 0.035 M=-0.035 , p Holm = .256 p_{\text{Holm}}=.256 ), and positive in one model (Qwen3-thinking, + 0.03 +0.03 ), so we classify it as absent. We therefore describe framing as reversed; escalation, confirmation, and loss aversion as directional, meaning opposite to the human direction in every model with item-level reliability that five items cannot establish; and availability as absent. No bias qualifies as deliberation-responsive; all six per-bias slope tests on realized tokens are null after correction.

blocks.en: IV-D RQ4: Forcing the model to verbalize the anchor
blocks.zh: IV-D RQ4:强迫模型将主播口音化

blocks.en: The verbalized condition adds one instruction to the anchoring treatment: restate every number in the prompt before answering. The change runs in the helpful direction on every one of the five anchoring items, with item means from − 0.004 -0.004 to − 0.036 -0.036 and a pooled mean of Δ = − 0.015 \Delta=-0.015 (95% CI [ − 0.026 , − 0.004 ] [-0.026,-0.004] over cells). Five of the seven models also move in that direction (Fig. 3 ). We therefore report the verbalization effect as directional rather than established: consistent across items and most models, small, and resting on five items. blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: This section interprets the main findings and draws out what they mean for deployment and for the deliberation analogy.
blocks.zh: 本节解释主要结论,并列出部署和审议类比的含义。

blocks.en: V-A A bias landscape that leans the wrong way
blocks.zh: 五A类 偏执的地貌 倾斜错误的方式

blocks.en: The most consistent result is not about reasoning at all. Across seven models spanning four training pipelines and both open and closed weights, anchoring runs in the human direction and four of the other five biases lean against it in every model (Fig. 2 ), while availability is small and inconsistent. At the item level that reversal is firmly established for framing and directional for escalation, confirmation, and loss aversion, so the strong form of the claim rests on one bias and the weaker form on four.
blocks.zh: 最一致的结果完全不是推理。 跨越四个培训管道和开口和闭口重量的7个模式,锚定在人的方向上,另外5个模式中有4个偏向于它(图2),而可用性小而不一致。 在项目一级,为确定和引导升级、确认和避免损失而确定逆转,因此索赔的有力形式取决于一种偏向,而较弱的形式取决于四种倾向。

blocks.en: This picture departs from the benchmark results of Malberg et al. [ 8 ] , who report bias-consistent behavior across their model panel, and from the one-sided framing in Knipper et al. [ 11 ] , where reasoning models show more resistance to framing. Three differences in method bear on the comparison. We sample ten responses per cell at temperature 1.0 and score the mean shift, rather than scoring single responses; we use five items per bias drawn from their pools; and our panel consists of models released in 2025 and later, after the alignment generations those studies evaluated. We cannot attribute the divergence to any one of these from our data. What we can say is that, for four biases, the sign of the reversal is uniform across our seven models, which is not what item sampling alone would produce, and that a one-sided “resistance” finding and a signed “reversal” finding are compatible: both say that reasoning models do not frame like people, and the signed metric adds that they move the other way.
blocks.zh: 这一情况不同于Malberg等人的基准结果。 [8],他们报告在他们的模型面板上,以及从Knipper等人的片面框架中,偏执一致的行为. [11],其中推理模型表现出更多的阻力来设定. 方法上的三个差异影响着比较。 我们以1.0温度对每个细胞的10个反应进行抽样,对平均变化进行评分,而不是对单个反应进行评分;我们使用从它们池中抽取的每个偏差的5个项目;我们的小组包括2025年公布的模型,以及稍后在对齐几代人之后公布的这些研究得到评价的模型。 我们不能将这种差异归因于我们的数据中的任何一种。 我们可以说,对于四种偏差来说,倒置的标志在我们七个模型中是统一的,这并非仅仅是物品取样能产生的结果,而片面的“抵抗”发现和签名的“逆向”发现是相容的:两者都说推理模型不像人那样框架,而签名的衡量标准又说它们走错了方向。

blocks.en: One reading of the reversal is that this is what heavy preference tuning looks like from the outside. Hagendorff et al. observed human-like biases weakening from GPT-3 to ChatGPT [ 19 ] , and Itzhak et al. showed that instruction tuning reshapes bias profiles in both directions [ 20 ] ; our data are consistent with that trajectory continuing past neutrality. Loss aversion is the suggestive case: its reversal is what a risk-neutral expected-value maximizer would produce on these choice pairs, and models trained to give “rational” answers may have internalized that norm, though with five items and a wide interval we present this as a hypothesis rather than a finding. Whatever the mechanism, the practical upshot holds for the biases that are reliably reversed: the familiar human bias catalog is the wrong checklist for auditing these systems. A review that asks “is the model framing-sensitive like a person?” will answer no and miss that the model deviates from frame-invariance just as far the other way.
blocks.zh: 一种对倒转的解读是,这就是从外界看重偏好调子的外观. 哈根多夫等编. 观察到类似人类的偏见从GPT-3到ChatGPT [19]被削弱,以及Itzhak等. 显示指令调整重塑了双向偏差剖面[20];我们的数据与过去一直保持中立的轨迹一致。 厌恶损失是暗示性案例:它倒置是风险中和的预期价值最大化器在这些选择对等上会产生什么,经过“合理”答案培训的模型可能已经将这一规范内部化,尽管有五个项目和很长的间隔,我们将此作为假设而不是结论。 不论机制如何,实际结果都有利于可靠地扭转的偏见:熟悉的人类偏见目录是审计这些系统的错误清单。 评论中询问“模型像一个人那样对框架敏感吗?” 将回答否,并错过模型偏离框架变化的路程。

blocks.en: V-B No debiasing dividend from deliberation
blocks.zh: 维-B 评议不减少红利

blocks.en: Against this backdrop, the reasoning results point one way. Matched within families, reasoning models are not less biased than their comparators (RQ1); the point estimates lean toward slightly more bias in every family, but the pooled interval includes zero and we do not claim a difference. Across the deliberation these models actually produced (RQ2), no model’s bias magnitude reliably declined. The qualification that the realized-token analysis adds is important: for GPT-5.1 the ceiling did not change how much the model thought, and for DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3 the ceiling was not enforced, so those three models provide a narrow dose range. Claude is the one model whose deliberation the ceiling controlled, from zero to several hundred tokens, and across that range its bias magnitude was flat while its signed score drifted slightly further from the human direction. The dual-process prediction, more deliberation, less bias, finds no support in the range tested. This does not mean the thinking is idle; on verifiable tasks it demonstrably helps [ 4 ] . It means the deliberation does not function as a bias corrector here, which fits the trace-level evidence that reasoning text and answer-driving computation can come apart [ 12 , 13 , 25 ] . Anchoring makes the point concretely: the anchor keeps its pull at the highest realized deliberation we observed, so whatever those tokens do, they do not include discounting the number that is biasing the answer.
blocks.zh: 在这种背景下,推理结果指出了一种方式。 根据家庭内部的匹配,推理模型的偏差不亚于其比较者(RQ1);点数估计倾向于每个家庭略多一点的偏差,但集合间隔包括零,我们并不声称有差异. 在整个审议过程中,这些模型实际产生(RQ2),没有模型的偏差幅度可靠地下降。 已实现的托肯分析补充的限定很重要:对于GPT-5.1,上限没有改变模型思考的多少;对于DeepSeek-R1和Qun3,上限没有强制实施,因此这三种模型提供了狭长的剂量范围. Claude是受天花板控制的一个模型,从零到几百个信使,从这个范围来看,它的偏差幅度是平平的,而其签字的分数则从人类方向略微偏移。 双过程预测,多考虑,少偏差,在所测试的范围中找不到支持. 这并不意味着思想是闲置的;在可核查的任务上,它显然有助于[4]。 这意味着审议不具有此处的偏差校正功能,这符合推理文本和答案驱动计算可以分解的微量证据[12,13,25]. 安克林具体地说明了这一点:锚点保持了我们所观察到的最高实际审议,因此无论这些标志如何,它们都不包括对给答案带来偏见的数字的打折扣。

blocks.en: A methodological lesson sits beside the substantive one. A requested thinking ceiling, sent through a multi-provider gateway, produced three different realities: a ceiling that was honoured but rarely approached, a ceiling converted into a single effort setting, and a ceiling that was ignored. Studies that manipulate reasoning budget and do not log consumption cannot tell these cases apart. We recommend reporting realized reasoning tokens per condition as a matter of course.
blocks.zh: 方法方面的教训与实质性教训相提并论。 通过一个多供应商网关发送的要求的思维上限产生了三个不同的现实:一个上限得到遵守,但很少接近;一个上限转变为单一的努力设定;一个被忽略的上限。 操纵推理预算和不记录消费的研究无法将这些情况分开。 我们建议按每个条件报告实现的推理标志。

blocks.en: V-C Anchor restatement versus deliberation
blocks.zh: 维-C Anchor 重述与审议

blocks.en: The one intervention that moved anchoring was not more compute but a redirection of attention: asking the model to restate the anchor before answering lowered anchoring on all five items (RQ4). The size is modest, one model (DeepSeek-V3) shifted the other way, and with five items the effect does not reach significance, so we present this as a cheap mitigation worth testing rather than an established one. Still, the contrast with RQ2 is the useful part. For this bias, one line of prompt engineering did what the available deliberation did not, which suggests that targeted prompting and per-bias audits are currently a better use of effort than budget increases when the goal is judgment quality rather than task accuracy.
blocks.zh: 移动锚地的一次发言不是比较计算,而是转移了注意力:请模型在回答所有五个项目的锚地降低之前重述锚地(RQ4)。 体积不大,一个模型(DeepSeek-V3)向另一方向转移,如果有五个项目,效果就没有意义,所以我们把它称为廉价的缓解值测试,而不是既定的测试。 然而,与RQ2的对比是有用的部分. 对于这种偏见,一行快速工程做了现有审议所没有做的事情,这表明,当目标是判断质量而不是任务准确性时,有针对性的快速和逐一审计目前比增加预算更能更好地利用精力。

blocks.en: V-D Implications for practice
blocks.zh: 对实践的影响

blocks.en: Three recommendations follow. First, do not assume the reasoning tier of a model family is the lower-bias option; in our panel it never was, and the evidence gives no reason to expect it. Second, audit deployed models per bias and per direction, since for four of the six biases the sign of the deviation was model-agnostic here but its size varied by family. Third, where numeric anchors are a known hazard, an anchor-restating instruction is a low-cost mitigation worth testing in context.
blocks.zh: 以下三项建议。 首先,不要假设模范家庭的推理层次是低偏颇的选择;在我们小组中,它从未如此,而且证据没有理由期望它。 第二,审计采用了每个偏差和每个方向的模型,因为对于六个偏差中的四个,偏差的标志在这里是模型不可知的,但其大小因家庭而异。 第三,如果数字锚是已知的危险,则锚地恢复指令是一种在上下文中值得进行低成本的缓解测试。

blocks.en: VI Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 限制

blocks.en: The design has boundaries worth stating plainly. The stimuli are vignettes from a single benchmark family; vignette-based measurement is the standard paradigm in both the human and machine literatures [ 6 , 8 ] , but effects can be sensitive to phrasing, and five items per bias is a narrow base. That narrowness is why three of the four reversals and the RQ4 verbalization effect are reported as directional rather than reliable, and why availability is classified as absent: with five items per bias, an item-level test has four degrees of freedom, and effects that are consistent in sign across every item and model can still fall short of significance. The deliberation manipulation did not work uniformly: realized reasoning tokens rose with the requested ceiling for Claude, were constant for GPT-5.1, and were uncapped for DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3, so the dose-response conclusion is bounded by the realized ranges in Table IV , and we cannot speak to deliberation beyond roughly 3,400 tokens per cell. For the two no-disable models the reasoning contrast crosses a sibling boundary and so confounds deliberation with weights; the Claude and OpenAI contrasts hold weights constant and are the cleaner evidence for RQ1. Our claims are behavioral: the study measures what the models do, not why, and the overcorrection reading of the reversals is an interpretation the data are consistent with, not a demonstrated mechanism. Finally, all calls went through one routing provider during one collection window; model updates behind fixed identifiers are a general reproducibility hazard, which the released harness, frozen battery, and per-call usage logs mitigate but cannot remove.
blocks.zh: 设计有边界,值得明确说明。 刺激是出自单一基准家族的活字;以活字为主的测量是人文和机器文献中的标准范式[6,8],但效果可以对用词敏感,每个偏差五个项目是一个狭小的基础. 这种狭义性是四个倒置和RQ4口语化效应中三个被报告为方向性而非可靠性的原因,也是为什么可用性被归类为缺失的原因:每个偏差有五个项目,一个项级测试有四个自由度,在每个项和模型上签名一致的效果仍然不能达到意义. 考虑操纵没有统一发挥作用:实现的推理符号随着Claude要求的上限而上升,GPT-5.1是常数,对于DeepSeek-R1和Qun3是没有被封住的,因此剂量-反应结论以表四中实现的范围为界,我们不能说每个单元格中大约3,400个符号之外的审议。 对于两个"不残疾"模型,推理对比跨越了双胞胎的分界线,因此将考虑与权重混为一谈;克洛德和OpenAI对比具有权重常数,是RQ1的更清洁的证据. 我们的主张是行为性的: 研究测量模型是做什么的,而不是为什么的, 对倒转的过度校正读取是一种解释, 数据是符合的,而不是一个证明的机制。 最后,在一个收集窗口内,所有电话都通过一个线路提供者;固定识别器后面的模型更新是一种一般的可复制性危险,释放的电源、被冻结的电池和按呼的用法记录可以减轻但不能去除。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We asked whether test-time reasoning immunizes language models against human cognitive biases, and within the deliberation these models actually produced, the answer is no on every axis measured: reasoning models are not less biased than matched siblings, bias magnitude does not reliably fall as realized deliberation grows, and the one bias that behaves like its human counterpart, anchoring, is as strong at the highest deliberation observed as at none. What the data show instead is a bias landscape that leans against the human catalog, consistently across seven models for four biases and reliably so for framing, together with a small, cheap prompt intervention that moved anchoring on every item where compute did not. A requested thinking budget turned out to be a poor proxy for thinking done, which is itself a finding this literature should absorb. For a venue concerned with cognitive machine intelligence, the message cuts both ways. The dual-process analogy earns its keep as a hypothesis generator, but its central prediction fails in the range tested, and evaluation practice should follow the data: measure biases in both directions, per model, log the deliberation that actually occurred, and treat requested budget as a cost knob rather than a rationality guarantee.
blocks.zh: 我们问测试时间推理是否免疫了语言模型与人类认知偏差,在实际产生的这些模型的审议中,答案不是每个轴线上的:推理模型的偏差不低于对应的兄弟姐妹;偏见的程度不会随着实际考虑的增加而可靠地下降;一种表现得像人类对等者那样的偏差,锚定,在最高的审议中表现得和没有一样强烈。 数据所显示的是一个偏颇的地貌,它与人类目录相对立, 一致地跨越七个模型,用于四种偏差, 并且可靠地用于设定, 再加上一个小小的,廉价的即时干预, 将锚定在每一个没有计算的项目上。 要求的思考预算证明对于所完成的思考来说是一个糟糕的代名词,而这本身就是文献应该吸收的发现. 对于一个涉及认知机器智能的场所来说,信息会双向切入. 双进程类比作为假说生成者获得其保留,但其中心预测在所测试的范围内失败了,评价实践应当遵循数据:按模型衡量双向偏差,记录实际发生的审议情况,并将所请求的预算视为成本取向而不是合理性保证.
